name: DataXAPI
description: One key and one response shape for public posts, comments, creators, ads and products across Chinese and global platforms. Free trial up to 333 calls.
notes: REST API with an OpenAPI spec at https://dataxapi.com/openapi.json, SDKs on npm and PyPI, and a CLI. Every response says what the call cost. Free trial up to 333 calls, then pay per call from $0.0003.
